title: RUSCUAV: A Semantic Mission-Acceptability Benchmark for Low-Altitude Urban Cargo UAV Navigation
description: RUSCUAV is a benchmark for low-altitude urban cargo-UAV navigation that scores missions by semantic mission acceptability (cargo health, time over roads, pedestrian ways, buildings and sensitive zones, hard violations) as well as by target-reaching success. The ruscuav-benchmark package provides validated world files, a Gymnasium environment, the risk-cost A* planners and PPO policies of the paper, evaluation protocols with fixed missions, scoring of any method's trajectories, the paper's statistics, and a builder of worlds from OpenStreetMap data. The archived evaluations, trained weights and paper-ready tables of the associated manuscript are the RUSCUAV v2.0.0 dataset on Zenodo, a new version of the record of v1.0.0 (10.5281/zenodo.21331403).
